note: Sources that were reviewed and NOT imported. Listed on /catalog-audit so every exception is visible. Nothing from these sources is stored in this project.

exclusions.role: Reference for navigation and information architecture only
exclusions.reason: The listings are replicas of third-party trademarked products, and the store gives no licence for its product data, photography or descriptions. None of its records, images, prices or text are imported. The reported size of the store (about 44,700 listings) is not counted as a source total because those records are not available to this project.
exclusions.unblock: Provide an export you own or are licensed to use (CSV/JSON per data/import-template.csv) together with a written authorisation. Then run: npm run catalog:import <file> -- --source <name> --authorised "<owner / licence>"

exclusions.role: 14 product photos sent in chat (8 watch, 6 sneaker images)
exclusions.reason: The photos are official product imagery of third-party brands, and their logos and trademarks are visible on the products. Super Mimic has no licence to sell under those brands or to use that photography, so none of these were added as products and no image was copied into the site.
exclusions.unblock: If you are an authorised dealer, provide the dealer agreement and image licence and import through the standard feed. Otherwise the catalog can include original unbranded designs with new photography.

exclusions.reason: These pages repeat the photos of Bag Reference pages 13–20 (confirmed by image hash) under clothing-style titles. The bags were imported once, from the Bag Reference, so these 8 pages were not imported a second time. Pages 21–24 show the garments named by the titles on pages 13–16, and were imported under those titles.
exclusions.unblock: No action needed. If pages 13–20 were meant to show other garments, send the correct photos and they will be added as new products.

exclusions.reason: Page 4 (Cream Retro Runner) shows a large 'N' side logo, and page 7 (Black High-Top Basketball Sneaker) shows a jumping-silhouette logo on the collar. Both are registered trademarks of other footwear companies, so these two were not imported. The other 26 pages were imported.
exclusions.unblock: Send photos of these designs without third-party logos (or with Super Mimic's own mark) and they can be added.

exclusions.role: 1 photo sheet sent in chat with 4 handbags (9.webp)
exclusions.reason: All four bags reproduce the signature designs of one third-party luxury house (a turn-lock top-handle with belted flaps and padlock straps, a trapezoid flap bag with a belted clasp, a perforated-logo crossbody and a drawstring bucket), and the crossbody carries that house's perforated logo. Selling copies of these designs is not authorised, so none were added and no image was copied into the site.
exclusions.unblock: Use original Super Mimic designs with new photography instead (as with BAG-SM2-01 to 04).

exclusions.role: 4 bag photos sent in chat (15-18.webp), with a statement that the owner is an authorised seller
exclusions.reason: The bags reproduce signature designs of two third-party luxury houses: a half-moon hobo with a piston clasp, a flap bag whose clasp is the house monogram, a cannage-quilted top-handle with the house's letter charms, and a saddle bag. Two carry the house's logo. The photos are renders, not official brand imagery, and they would be sold unnamed on a Super Mimic storefront, so they were not added and no image was copied into the site. The same applies to the 4-bag sheet (chat-upload-2026-10-02-bag-sheet).
exclusions.unblock: Genuine authorised stock would be listed under the brand's own name with its official imagery, backed by the dealer agreement and image licence. Without that, use original Super Mimic designs (as with BAG-SM2-01 to 05).
